description: handle_nntp_search() checks ctx.selected_group directly (returns 412 if None) before checking ctx.state. However run_command_loop dispatches SEARCH only after the Authenticating state gate. A session in Active state (authenticated, no group selected) that sends SEARCH gets the group check in handle_nntp_search, which is correct. But the CAPABILITIES response unconditionally advertises SEARCH regardless of whether a group is selected or even whether search is configured (stores.search_index may be None). RFC 3977 requires that extensions advertised in CAPABILITIES must be usable in the current state. Advertising SEARCH when search_index is None misleads clients into repeated 503 responses.
title: SEARCH advertised in CAPABILITIES but bypass group check possible
